Our listing converts like crazy — but we’re not getting enough eyes. Our icon/title aren’t stopping the scroll. excerpt_i18n.en:
On October 10, 2025, the vivo Developer Conference (VDC) took place in Shenzhen, where the highly anticipated OriginOS 6 system was officially unveiled, drawing widespread attention both inside and outside the venue. However, in the view of Leifeng.com, the true hidden star of this VDC was the 2025 Blue Heart Intelligent Strategy, as the content of this strategic upgrade directly impacts the personal experience of every user.

With the strategic upgrade, vivo's Blue Heart large model achieved comprehensive breakthroughs. By 2025, AI in China is no longer a distant concept. Data shows that 78% of enterprises use AI in their operations, and 71% rely on generative AI for marketing, operations, and product development. When it comes to the practicality of AI, most people would likely answer affirmatively.

Yet, such AI often carries a bit of a "corporate feel" and hasn't truly integrated into the daily lives of ordinary people. Take the most frequently used device—the smartphone—as an example: how many AI-related features do you actually use? Probably, most people only treat large AI models as search engines; while "practical," they aren't considered "user-friendly."

So, how can large AI models become more integrated into our lives and more user-friendly? vivo's answer is "personalization." Indeed, current large models have extensive knowledge of the world but relatively little and short-term understanding of individuals, making it difficult to provide sustained, long-term personal service. Only when models become personalized can the full potential of large models be unleashed.

However, achieving personalized intelligence is no easy task.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 10 de octubre de 2025, la Conferencia de Desarrolladores de vivo (VDC) se celebró en Shenzhen, donde el muy esperado sistema OriginOS 6 hizo su debut oficial, atrayendo innumerables miradas dentro y fuera del recinto. Sin embargo, en opinión de Leifeng, el verdadero "protagonista oculto" de esta VDC fue en realidad la "Estrategia de Inteligencia Blue Heart 2025", ya que el contenido de esta actualización estratégica afecta la experiencia personal de cada usuario. Con la mejora estratégica, el gran modelo Blue Heart de vivo logró avances integrales. Al entrar en 2025, la IA en China ya no es un concepto inalcanzable. Los datos muestran que el 78% de las empresas utilizan IA en sus operaciones, y el 71% también emplea IA generativa para marketing, mantenimiento y desarrollo.

title_i18n.es: Ante la presentación consecutiva de dos modelos con un billón de parámetros, Ant AI llega con fuerza arrolladora.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 刚刚过去的国庆，各行各业进入放假模式，但大模型行业却一刻也没闲着。 过去的半个月，国内外大模型的头部团队有十余款重磅产品发布，但每个团队的产品侧重不同。 其中，九月下旬，阿里发布以 Qwen3-Max 为代表的全家桶产品，大秀了一把肌肉；九月末，DeepSeek 和 Anthropic 瞄准真实编程场景，先后发布了 DeepSeek V3.2-Exp 和 Claude Sonnet 4.5，此外，智谱也拿出 GLM-4.6，目标冲击国内最强代码模型。 有人全盘布局，也有人专攻精尖，在大模型领域竞争驶向深水区后，各个公司战略路线出现了分野。 10 月 9 日凌晨，蚂蚁百灵大模型团队奇袭般官宣了一款自家最新语言大模型 Ling-1T，参数量达到 1000B（即 1万亿参数）。然而，就在十天前，百灵团队才将自研 Ring-1T-preview 大模型开源。 短短十天内，发布并开源两款万亿参数模型，如此密集的产品发布让蚂蚁百灵大模型成为了行业热议对象。 与此同时，这样毫无保留的开源动作，也让业界猜测：蚂蚁到底意图何在？ 01 探索智能上限是终极目标 据雷峰网了解，蚂蚁集团研发的基础大模型取名“百灵”，寓意“百试百灵”，也蕴含科技普惠之意，和阿里一样，蚂蚁也是独立团队独立研发，Ling-1T 和 Ring-1T-preview 分别是蚂蚁百灵团队研发的非思考模型和思考模型。 过去半年时间里，蚂蚁一直在对百灵大模型进行迭代优化，并且自上而下形成了三条技术探索路线： 一条是以 MoE 架构为基础的非思考模型 Ling-Series，另一条是思考模型 R
excerpt_i18n.en: During the recent National Day holiday, while various industries entered a break mode, the large model sector remained highly active. Over the past half-month, more than ten major products were launched by leading teams in the field, each with distinct focuses. In late September, Alibaba showcased its strength by releasing a full suite of products, represented by Qwen3-Max. At the end of September, DeepSeek and Anthropic targeted real-world programming scenarios, successively introducing DeepSeek V3.2-Exp and Claude Sonnet 4.5, while Zhipu unveiled GLM-4.6, aiming to become the top code model in China. As competition in the large model domain intensifies, companies have diverged in their strategic approaches, with some pursuing comprehensive layouts and others specializing in cutting-edge areas. On the early morning of October 9, Ant Group's Bailing large model team surprisingly announced its latest language model, Ling-1T, with a parameter count of 1000B (1 trillion parameters). However, just ten days prior, the Bailing team had open-sourced its self-developed Ring-1T-preview model. Releasing and open-sourcing two trillion-parameter models within such a short span highlights the intense product rollout pace of Ant Bailing.
excerpt_i18n.es: Durante las recientes vacaciones nacionales, mientras diversos sectores entraban en modo de descanso, la industria de los grandes modelos no se detuvo ni un momento. En las últimas dos semanas, los principales equipos de grandes modelos, tanto nacionales como internacionales, lanzaron más de diez productos destacados, cada uno con enfoques distintos. A finales de septiembre, Alibaba presentó su conjunto completo de productos, destacando Qwen3-Max para demostrar su fortaleza; a finales de mes, DeepSeek y Anthropic, enfocándose en escenarios de programación real, lanzaron sucesivamente DeepSeek V3.2-Exp y C.
